compDef: The smithy's lofty ceiling is comprised of rough, smoke-darkened tinders. The cavernous space holds a man-sized anvil and a forge fed by a low-burning flame that nonetheless fills the smithy with skin-searing heat. Hafts for gigantic axes and a whalebone pommel meant for an immense sword sit atop a huge worktable of sturdy hoarbeam.
You also see a burly goliath engineer who is riding a tawny armor-clad pegasus and a pale mistwood runestaff capped by a rough multicolored gemstone.
